title: Runtime admin API-key header contract repair

phases.objective: Repair the admin authentication header contract used by the Main review-policy and Migration 1051 readiness runners while preserving read-only readiness and all live mutation boundaries.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The existing live activation contract test runs on the exact PR candidate.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Both runners send BACKEND_API_KEY through x-api-key, matching the auth.mad4b.com admin/service contract, and the regression guard rejects the old Bearer form.
steps: Read the runtime endpoint contract and reproduce the unauthenticated 401 response without credentials.
Update only the request header construction in the Main policy and Migration 1051 runners.
Register the changed Migration 1051 runner in both governance control-plane registries.
Regenerate Repository Inventory and Repository Evaluation through official generators.
Run the existing policy, readback, governance, environment-impact, and derived-state checks on the exact candidate.
Keep readiness read-only and leave Branch Protection, Rulesets, database, migration, provider, and Production effects disabled.
assertions: The runtime admin/service request uses x-api-key: BACKEND_API_KEY.
The runners do not use Authorization: Bearer BACKEND_API_KEY.
The changed critical governance path is registered in Constitution.control_plane_paths and convergence.automation_control_paths.
Environment impact is explicitly declared for staging and production.
Live staging certification remains required and production mutation remains false.
No Branch Protection or Rulesets Apply, migration, grant, SQL/DB mutation, provider mutation, credential payload read, force-push, or Production activation occurs.
